items.title: Why the data center you dread might never even be built
items.summary: The data center boom is running into serious real-world obstacles, from widespread local opposition and permitting delays to a scramble for electricity. Before those challenges even come into play, though, there’s a more basic problem: A lot of the projects being announced may never get built in the first place. With billions of dollars in AI infrastructure […]
items.creator: Theresa Loconsolo, Rebecca Bellan, Tim De Chant

items.title: Olaf Sakkers is betting he can beat the emerging-manager squeeze
items.summary: Entering into the world of venture capital has never been easy, especially as a first-time fund manager. But it's especially daunting right now. Olaf Sakkers has spent the past five years proving that difficult doesn't mean impossible.
items.creator: Connie Loizos
